tools.name: analysis.amplitudeStats
tools.description:
Amplitude Statistics for the current scope — peak, RMS, dynamic range, DC offset
and possibly-clipped sample count, as a readable summary.

tools.name: analysis.histogram
tools.description:
Amplitude histogram for the current scope — the dBFS distribution of sample
values: the modal (most common) level, how many bins hold ≥1% of the samples,
and the total sample count.

tools.name: analysis.loudness
tools.description:
Loudness metering for the current scope — EBU R128 / ITU-R BS.1770 integrated
loudness (LUFS), True Peak (dBTP, oversampled), short-term max and the
Loudness Range (LRA), as shown in Audition's Loudness / Match Loudness panel.

tools.name: analysis.loudnessGraph
tools.description:
Loudness Radar — loudness over time for the current scope. Reports the momentary
loudness span (min … max), the integrated value, the range, and how many
momentary / short-term points were measured.

tools.name: analysis.markAudio
tools.description:
Mark Audio: detect the non-silent regions of the mix and drop a range marker on
each (great for splitting a long recording into takes).

thresholdDb.description: Level at or below which audio counts as silence, dBFS.

minSilenceMs.description: A silent gap at least this long separates two regions, ms.

tools.name: analysis.markBeats
tools.description:
Mark Beats: detect the rhythmic onsets of the mix and drop a cue marker on
each (Audition's "generate markers from beats").

sensitivity.description: Onset threshold as a multiple of the mean energy flux (higher = fewer beats).

tools.name: analysis.phaseAnalysis
tools.description:
Phase Analysis for the current scope — stereo correlation (−1 out of phase … +1
in phase), balance, width and mono compatibility.

tools.name: analysis.pitch
tools.description:
Pitch detection for the current scope — the dominant fundamental (Hz), its
nearest note + octave, cents off, and a confidence (YIN algorithm).

tools.name: analysis.spectrogram
tools.description:
Spectrogram (Spectral Frequency Display) of the current scope — reports the
matrix dimensions and the loudest time/frequency cell.

tools.name: analysis.tempo
tools.description:
Tempo / beat detection for the current scope — reports the estimated BPM and
how many rhythmic onsets were found, without changing the project.

sensitivity.description: Onset threshold as a multiple of the mean energy flux (higher = fewer beats).

tools.name: analysis.vectorscope
tools.description:
Phase Scope / vectorscope of the current scope — reports the goniometer point
cloud's shape (vertical = mono, horizontal = out of phase, diagonal = offset).

tools.name: app.applyKeyboardShortcutPreset
tools.description: Apply an app-global keyboard shortcut preset to the current project.

tools.name: app.deleteKeyboardShortcutPreset
tools.description: Delete an app-global keyboard shortcut preset.

tools.name: app.discoverControlSurfaces
tools.description: Discover browser/WebView-visible MIDI control surface ports.

requestPermission.description: Request Web MIDI permission before listing ports. (0 or 1)

tools.name: app.exportKeyboardShortcutPreset
tools.description: Export an app-global keyboard shortcut preset as JSON.

tools.name: app.getAudioHardwarePreferences
tools.description: Get app-global audio hardware defaults used by New Session.

tools.name: app.getControlSurfacePreferences
tools.description: Get app-global MIDI/control-surface preferences.

tools.name: app.getFilePreferences
tools.description: Get app-global file behavior preferences for default mixdown and batch export.

tools.name: app.getPanelPreferences
tools.description: Get app-global Analyze and Effects panel defaults used by New Session.

tools.name: app.getWorkspacePreferences
tools.description: Get app-global workspace/editor defaults used by New Session.

tools.name: app.importKeyboardShortcutPreset
tools.description: Import an app-global keyboard shortcut preset from JSON.

presetJson.description: JSON object with id, name, and shortcuts.

tools.name: app.listKeyboardShortcutPresets
tools.description: List app-global keyboard shortcut presets stored for this Rythme installation.

tools.name: app.saveKeyboardShortcutPreset
tools.description: Save the current project keyboard shortcut overrides as an app-global preset.

tools.name: app.setAudioHardwarePreferences
tools.description: Set app-global audio hardware defaults used by New Session.

inputDeviceId.description: Browser/native input device id, or empty for system default.

outputDeviceId.description: Browser/native output device id, or empty for system default.

hardwareSampleRate.description: Requested hardware sample rate in Hz.

countInBars.description: Count-in length in bars before recording.

meterCalibrationDb.description: Display offset applied to meter dB readouts.

meterPeakHoldMs.description: Software mixer meter peak-hold duration in milliseconds.

tools.name: app.setControlSurfaceMappings
tools.description: Set app-global custom MIDI control mappings from JSON.

mappingsJson.description: JSON array of mapping objects with trigger/status/data1 and action/type fields.

tools.name: app.setControlSurfacePreferences
tools.description: Set app-global MIDI/control-surface preferences.

enabled.description: Whether the configured surface is enabled. (0 or 1)

protocol.description: Surface protocol: genericMidi, mackieControl, or hui.

inputId.description: MIDI input id, or empty for none.

outputId.description: MIDI output id, or empty for none.

tools.name: app.setFilePreferences
tools.description: Set app-global file behavior preferences for default mixdown and batch export.

exportFloat.description: Use 32-bit float WAV when exportFormat is "wav" and bitDepth is 32. (0 or 1)

tools.name: app.setPanelPreferences
tools.description: Set app-global Analyze and Effects panel defaults used by New Session.

defaultsJson.description: JSON object with optional analyze and effects preference sections.

tools.name: app.setWorkspacePreferences
tools.description: Set app-global workspace/editor defaults used by New Session.

defaultWorkspaceId.description: Built-in workspace id: default, maxWaveform, maxSpectral, mixing, or radio.

editorMode.description: Default editor mode: multitrack or waveform.

tool.description: Default tool: select, razor, marquee, envelope, fade, marker, hand, or zoom.

snap.description: Whether snapping is enabled by default (0/1).

displayTimeFormat.description: Display time format: decimal, smpte30, samples, or barsBeats.

tools.name: bus.setAutomationMode
tools.description:
Set a bus automation mode. "off" bypasses bus automation during render;
write/touch/latch persist the session mode for automation workflows.

tools.name: clip.autoCrossfade
tools.description:
Auto-Crossfade every overlapping pair of clips on a track — the earlier clip
fades out as the later fades in across the overlap (Audition's multitrack
crossfade), smoothing the seam.

track.description: Track index whose overlapping clips to crossfade, 0-based.

linear.description: Use a linear (equal-gain) curve instead of equal-power (0 = equal-power, 1 = linear).

tools.name: clip.matchVolume
tools.description:
Match Clip Volume — bring the selected clips to a common level by setting each
clip's gain trim (non-destructive); matches to the loudest clip in the set.

tools.name: clip.merge
tools.description:
Merge Clips — render the currently selected clips (which must share a track)
into a single clip spanning from the earliest start to the latest end, the
inverse of Split.

tools.name: clip.setAutomationMode
tools.description:
Set a clip automation mode by clip id. "off" bypasses clip automation during render;
write/touch/latch persist the session mode for automation workflows.

tools.name: clip.splitAtMarkers
tools.description:
Split Clips at Markers — razor every clip at each marker position (region
markers cut at both edges), turning Mark Audio / Mark Beats markers into clip
boundaries.

tools.name: effect.applyFavorite
tools.description: Apply a saved Favorite effect chain by id or exact name to the current edit scope.

idOrName.description: Favorite chain id or exact favorite name.

tools.name: effect.autoPhaseCorrect
tools.description: Apply Automatic Phase Correction (inter-channel alignment) over the current scope.

maxShiftMs.description: Maximum inter-channel lag searched in ms, 0 = polarity only.

correctPolarity.description: Flip the right channel if the channels are anti-correlated.

tools.name: effect.convertSampleType
tools.description: Convert Sample Type over the current scope — change channel count and/or bit depth.

dither.description: Add triangular dither when lowering the bit depth.

tools.name: effect.convolutionIr
tools.description:
Apply Convolution Reverb using a supplied impulse-response audio file. The
IR must be base64-encoded WAV or AIFF bytes; Rythme decodes, downmixes,
energy-normalizes, and applies it to the current effect scope.

name.description: File name for format sniffing, e.g. "room.wav" or "hall.aiff".

tools.name: effect.deleteSilence
tools.description: Delete Silence over the current scope — trim the gaps between phrases.

thresholdDb.description: Level at or below which audio counts as silence, dBFS.

minSilenceMs.description: Only gaps at least this long are trimmed, ms.

keepMs.description: Silence left in each trimmed gap, ms; 0 removes it entirely.

tools.name: effect.essentialDuck
tools.description:
Essential Sound Auto-Duck: bake ducking onto every Music-role track using
every Dialogue-role track as a key.

amountDb.description: Attenuation while dialogue is active, dB.

thresholdDb.description: Dialogue level that engages ducking, dBFS.

attackMs.description: Time to duck down once dialogue crosses threshold, ms.

releaseMs.description: Time to recover after dialogue falls silent, ms.

holdMs.description: Keep ducking this long after dialogue drops below threshold, ms.

tools.name: effect.essentialSound
tools.description:
Essential Sound role preset for the current scope. If role is "auto", Rythme
uses the active track's assigned role, then falls back to Dialogue.

role.description: Role preset to apply, or "auto" to use the active track role.

tools.name: effect.fullReverb
tools.description: Apply a Full Reverb (synthesized colored-IR convolution reverb) over the current scope.

decayMs.description: Decay time / RT60 in ms — how long the tail lasts.

perception.description: Room irregularity: higher = more, more-varied early reflections.

colorHighDb.description: Coloration high-shelf gain in dB at ~6 kHz — negative darkens the tail.

tools.name: effect.gainEnvelope
tools.description:
Apply a Gain Envelope (time-varying amplitude) over the current scope, as a
start → middle → end shape (1 = unity, 0 = silence, >1 = boost).

startGain.description: Linear gain at the start of the selection.

midGain.description: Linear gain at the middle of the selection.

endGain.description: Linear gain at the end of the selection.

spline.description: Use a smooth spline curve instead of straight segments.

tools.name: effect.graphicEq
tools.description: Apply a Graphic Equalizer (10-band octave EQ) preset over the current scope.

preset.description: Tone-shaping curve: bassBoost · trebleBoost · loudness · vocalPresence · midScoop · telephone.

tools.name: effect.graphicPhaseShifter
tools.description: Apply a Graphic Phase Shifter (magnitude-preserving all-pass) over the current scope.

phaseDeg.description: Uniform phase shift across all frequencies, in degrees.

tools.name: effect.mastering
tools.description:
Apply an Audition-style Mastering rack preset over the current scope. "Open"
enables the ambience/reverb stage; the other presets preserve duration.

tools.name: effect.parametricEq
tools.description: Apply a Parametric Equalizer (free-form shelf + bell cascade) preset over the current scope.

preset.description: Curve: vocalClarity · warm · bright · deMud · loudness · lofi.

tools.name: effect.pitchShift
tools.description: Pitch-shift the current selection (or scope) by semitones, preserving duration.

tools.name: effect.remixToDuration
tools.description:
Remix the current selection/scope to a target duration without changing
playback speed or pitch, using crossfaded music-bed edits.

crossfadeMs.description: Crossfade length at loop/cut points, ms.

tools.name: effect.saveFavoriteRack
tools.description: Save the selected clip rack, active track rack, or master rack as a project Favorite.

name.description: Optional favorite name. Defaults to the active rack name.

tools.name: effect.scientificFilter
tools.description: Apply a Scientific Filter (high-order analog-prototype IIR) over the current scope.

order.description: Prototype order; band-pass/stop realize twice this.

cutoffHz.description: Corner frequency in Hz; lower edge for band-pass/stop.

cutoffHz2.description: Upper edge in Hz for band-pass/stop.

tools.name: effect.sidechainCompress
tools.description:
Sidechain Compressor — compress the active track using the key track as the
detector (the "pumping" effect), baking the result over the active track's
timeline. Continuous and proportional, unlike the binary Auto-Duck.

thresholdDb.description: Key level above which the target is compressed, dBFS.

kneeDb.description: Soft-knee width around the threshold, dB.

makeupDb.description: Make-up gain applied to the whole target, dB.

tools.name: effect.sidechainDuck
tools.description:
Sidechain Ducking (Auto-Duck) — dip the active track whenever the key track is
present, baking the result over the active track's timeline. Like Audition's
Essential Sound ▸ Ducking (music ducks under dialogue).

keyTrack.description: Index of the track that triggers ducking (0-based).

amountDb.description: Attenuation while the key is active, dB.

thresholdDb.description: Key level that engages ducking, dBFS.

attackMs.description: Time to duck down once the key crosses the threshold, ms.

releaseMs.description: Time to recover after the key falls silent, ms.

holdMs.description: Keep ducking this long after the key drops below threshold, ms.

tools.name: effect.sidechainGate
tools.description:
Sidechain Gate — gate the active track by the key track so it is audible only
while the key plays (the inverse of Auto-Duck), baked over the active track's
timeline. A keyed / "trance" gate.

thresholdDb.description: Key level above which the gate opens, dBFS.

rangeDb.description: Attenuation while the gate is closed, dB.

attackMs.description: Time to open once the key crosses the threshold, ms.

holdMs.description: Keep the gate open after the key drops below threshold, ms.

releaseMs.description: Time to close after the hold, ms.

tools.name: effect.spectralGain
tools.description: Apply gain to a rectangular spectral selection: time range plus frequency band.

gainDb.description: Gain applied inside the rectangle; -120 is practical silence.

tools.name: effect.splitBands
tools.description:
Frequency Band Splitter: split the current scope into bands at the two crossover
frequencies, each on its own new track (three bands; the bands recombine exactly).

tools.name: effect.stereoExpander
tools.description: Apply a Stereo Expander (stereo width + centre placement) over the current scope.

expand.description: Stereo width: 100 = unchanged, 0 = mono, up to 300 = wide.

tools.name: effect.swapChannels
tools.description: Swap the left and right channels over the current scope.

tools.name: effect.timeStretch
tools.description: Time-stretch the current selection (or scope) by a factor, preserving pitch.

tools.name: effect.truePeakLimiter
tools.description:
True Peak (ISP) Limiter over the current scope — a brickwall limiter that holds
the inter-sample (true) peak under a dBTP ceiling using 4× oversampled
detection, so the reconstructed signal never clips the converter.

releaseMs.description: Gain recovery time after a peak, ms.

tools.name: file.batchExport
tools.description:
Batch-export separate files from the current session: track stems, marker
regions, or selected clips. The files download through the same path as the
File menu's Batch Export commands.

bitDepth.description: PCM bit depth for the exported files; 0 uses app default.

tools.name: file.edl
tools.description:
Export the session timeline as CMX-style EDL text for Adobe Premiere import.
Use alongside WAV/AIFF stem export when the NLE needs media files.

frameRate.description: Non-drop-frame timeline rate for the EDL.

includeMuted.description: Include muted/disabled clips and tracks (0 or 1).

tools.name: file.premiereXml
tools.description:
Export the session timeline as Final Cut Pro 7 XML text for Adobe Premiere
import. Use alongside WAV/AIFF stem export when the NLE needs media files.

frameRate.description: Non-drop-frame timeline rate for the XML.

includeMuted.description: Include muted/disabled clips and tracks (0 or 1).

tools.name: generate.dtmf
tools.description:
Generate a DTMF dial-string clip (Audition Generate ▸ DTMF Signals), inserted
at the playhead. Keys 0–9, *, #, A–D; a space / comma / dash inserts a pause.

toneMs.description: Length of each key's tone, ms.

tools.name: generate.insert
tools.description: Generate a tone or noise clip and insert it at the playhead on the active track.

tools.name: generate.tones
tools.description:
Generate a Tones clip (Audition Generate ▸ Tones) with frequency modulation and
harmonics, inserted at the playhead on the active track.

modDepthHz.description: Frequency-modulation depth in Hz; the pitch swings ±depth/2.

modRateHz.description: Frequency-modulation rate in Hz, the warble speed.

tools.name: marker.exportCsv
tools.description:
Export the project's markers as Audition-style CSV (Name, Start, End, Duration,
Type), returned as text.

tools.name: marker.importCsv
tools.description: Import markers from an Audition-style marker CSV, adding them to the project.

csv.description: The CSV text (a header plus Name,Start,End,Duration,Type rows).

tools.name: mixer.meterBridge
tools.description:
Read the Mixer meter bridge at the playhead or an explicit timeline position,
reporting post-fader track, bus, master, insert-tap, and send-tap peak/RMS levels.

atSec.description: Timeline position in seconds. Negative values use the current playhead.

tools.name: multitrack.bounce
tools.description:
Bounce to a new track: render the active track (or the whole session mix) down
to a single clip on a brand-new track, leaving the sources intact.

scope.description: What to bounce: the active "track" or the entire "session" mix.

tools.name: plugin.addToTrackRack
tools.description:
Add a project-managed native audio plug-in to a track rack as an
inventory-only slot. This still does not host or process the plug-in.

tools.name: plugin.importCandidateMetadata
tools.description:
Import native audio plug-in candidates that already include scanner metadata,
such as version, bundle identifier, validation status, and validation issues.
This still does not host or process plug-ins.

candidatesJson.description: JSON array of candidate objects with at least a path.

tools.name: plugin.importCandidates
tools.description:
Scan candidate native audio plug-in paths and store the discovered inventory in
this project Audio Plug-In Manager. This still does not host or process plug-ins.

paths.description: Newline- or semicolon-separated candidate plug-in paths.

tools.name: plugin.importRoots
tools.description:
Recursively scan native audio plug-in search roots and store the discovered
inventory in this project Audio Plug-In Manager. This still does not host or
process plug-ins.

roots.description: Newline- or semicolon-separated plug-in search root folders.

maxDepth.description: Maximum nested folder depth below each root.

tools.name: plugin.listManaged
tools.description:
List the project-persisted Audio Plug-In Manager inventory, including
enablement, inventory-only host status, and stored preset metadata.

tools.name: plugin.scanCandidates
tools.description:
Inventory native audio plug-in candidate paths (.vst3, .vst, .component,
.dll, .so), returning format, name, status, and path. Candidate paths are
newline- or semicolon-separated. This does not host or process plug-ins.

paths.description: Newline- or semicolon-separated candidate plug-in paths.

tools.name: plugin.scanRoots
tools.description:
Recursively scan native audio plug-in search roots for .vst3, .vst,
.component, .dll, and .so candidates. This still does not host or process
plug-ins.

roots.description: Newline- or semicolon-separated plug-in search root folders.

maxDepth.description: Maximum nested folder depth below each root.

tools.name: plugin.searchRoots
tools.description:
List standard native audio plug-in search roots for VST3, VST2, and Audio
Units. This is inventory support only; Rythme does not host native plug-ins yet.

homeDir.description: Optional user home directory for per-user plug-in roots.

tools.name: plugin.setEnabled
tools.description: Enable or disable a project-managed native plug-in entry.

tools.name: plugin.setPreset
tools.description: Store preset/state metadata for a project-managed native plug-in entry.

presetName.description: Preset name to remember with the project.

stateJson.description: Optional JSON object of primitive state values.

tools.name: project.applyKeyboardShortcutPreset
tools.description: Apply a project keyboard shortcut preset to the active shortcut overrides.

tools.name: project.convertSampleRate
tools.description: Convert the whole session to a new sample rate (resamples every clip).

tools.name: project.deleteCustomWorkspace
tools.description: Delete a project-persisted custom workspace layout.

tools.name: project.deleteKeyboardShortcutPreset
tools.description: Delete a project keyboard shortcut preset.

tools.name: project.exportKeyboardShortcutPreset
tools.description: Export a project keyboard shortcut preset as JSON.

tools.name: project.importKeyboardShortcutPreset
tools.description: Import a keyboard shortcut preset from JSON.

presetJson.description: JSON object with id, name, and shortcuts.

tools.name: project.removeKeyboardShortcut
tools.description:
Remove a project-persisted keyboard shortcut override, restoring the built-in
default for that action.

tools.name: project.saveCustomWorkspace
tools.description:
Save a project-persisted custom workspace layout. If layoutJson is empty,
Rythme saves the default dock layout as the custom workspace seed.

layoutJson.description: Serialized DockLayout JSON, or empty to use the default layout.

tools.name: project.saveKeyboardShortcutPreset
tools.description: Save the current project keyboard shortcut overrides as a named preset.

tools.name: project.setAnalyzePanelPreferences
tools.description: Configure project-persisted Analyze panel spectral edit defaults.

spectralMinHz.description: Spectral selection lower bound in Hz.

spectralMaxHz.description: Spectral selection upper bound in Hz.

tools.name: project.setAudioHardware
tools.description: Configure session audio hardware and recording preferences.

inputDeviceId.description: Browser/native input device id, or empty for system default.

outputDeviceId.description: Browser/native output device id, or empty for system default.

hardwareSampleRate.description: Requested hardware sample rate in Hz.

countInBars.description: Count-in length in bars before recording.

meterCalibrationDb.description: Display offset applied to meter dB readouts.

meterPeakHoldMs.description: Software mixer meter peak-hold duration in milliseconds.

tools.name: project.setChannelCount
tools.description: Set the project output channel count for mono, stereo, or surround sessions.

tools.name: project.setEditorPreferences
tools.description:
Configure session editor display/editing preferences that persist with the
Rythme project.

tool.description: Default tool: select, razor, marquee, envelope, fade, marker, hand, or zoom.

snap.description: Whether snapping is enabled by default (0/1).

displayTimeFormat.description: Display time format: decimal, smpte30, samples, or barsBeats.

spectralMinHz.description: Spectral display lower bound in Hz.

spectralMaxHz.description: Spectral display upper bound in Hz.

tools.name: project.setEffectsPanelPreferences
tools.description: Configure project-persisted Effects panel default parameters from JSON.

defaultsJson.description: JSON object with EffectsPanelPreferences numeric fields.

tools.name: project.setKeyboardShortcut
tools.description:
Customize a project-persisted keyboard shortcut for an existing keyboard
action. The override replaces the built-in shortcut for that action.

action.description: Shortcut action id, such as edit.split, project.save, or tool.razor.

key.description: Key name, such as k, space, home, arrowleft, or backspace.

tools.name: project.setMasterAutomationMode
tools.description:
Set the master automation mode. "off" bypasses master automation during render;
write/touch/latch persist the session mode for automation workflows.

tools.name: project.setMasterGain
tools.description: Set the master output gain in decibels.

tools.name: project.setPunchRange
tools.description: Set or clear the punch-in recording range.

startSec.description: Punch-in start in seconds. Use a negative value to clear.

tools.name: project.setTempo
tools.description: Set the project tempo in beats per minute.

tools.name: session.new
tools.description: Start a new, empty session (4 tracks), replacing the current project.

tools.name: tool.set
tools.description: Select the active timeline tool.

tools.name: track.addRackSlot
tools.description:
Add a persistent built-in effect slot to a track's nondestructive rack.
Gain and pan slot ids can be passed to track.automateRackParam.

value.description: Primary initial value: gain dB, pan, threshold/ceiling dB, EQ gain/frequency, width, or delay time.

tools.name: track.automateRackParam
tools.description:
Add a persistent automation lane for a built-in track rack slot parameter.
Supports gain.gainDb and pan.pan; values are rendered as parameter offsets.

slotId.description: Effect slot id returned by track.addRackSlot.

param.description: Parameter to automate: "gainDb" for gain slots or "pan" for pan slots.

startValue.description: First point value in dB or pan units.

endValue.description: Second point value in dB or pan units.

tools.name: track.setAudioRole
tools.description:
Assign an Essential Sound role to a track for role presets and automatic
music-under-dialogue ducking.

role.description: Essential Sound role, or "none" to clear it.

tools.name: track.setAutomationMode
tools.description:
Set a track automation mode. "off" bypasses track automation during render;
write/touch/latch persist the session mode for automation workflows.

tools.name: track.setInput
tools.description: Assign a hardware input channel/device to a track for recording.

deviceId.description: Optional device id overriding the session input device.

tools.name: track.setSurroundPan
tools.description:
Set the 5.1 surround panner for a track. The project should have 6+ output
channels for this to affect rendering.

center.description: Amount sent to the center speaker.

tools.name: transport.play
tools.description: Start playback from the current playhead.

tools.name: transport.returnToZero
tools.description: Stop and return the playhead to the start (or the selection start).

tools.name: transport.seek
tools.description: Move the playhead to a position in seconds.

tools.name: transport.stop
tools.description: Stop playback.

tools.name: transport.toggle
tools.description: Toggle playback (play if stopped, stop if playing).

tools.name: transport.toggleMetronome
tools.description: Toggle the metronome on or off.

tools.name: view.setEditorMode
tools.description: Switch between Rythme's Audition-style editor surfaces.

tools.name: view.setWorkspace
tools.description: Select the active project workspace by built-in or custom workspace id.

tools.name: view.zoom
tools.description: Set the timeline zoom in pixels per second.

pxPerSecond.description: Horizontal zoom in pixels per second.

tools.name: view.zoomBy
tools.description: Zoom the timeline in or out by a multiplicative factor.

factor.description: Zoom factor (>1 zooms in, <1 zooms out).
